title: Reconcile Account
subtitle: Match your records against your bank statement

setup.title: Start Reconciliation
setup.intro: Reconcile your account against a bank statement to ensure your records match.

list.heading: Unreconciled Transactions ({count})
list.empty: No unreconciled transactions found for this period.
list.groupByFlow: Group by money in and out

complete.title: Reconciliation Complete
complete.message: Your account has been successfully reconciled as of {date}.
complete.existingPayment: This account has a scheduled payment, {name}. Would you like to update its next instance to the reconciled balance of {amount}?
complete.noPayment: No scheduled payment was found for this account. Would you like to create one for the reconciled balance of {amount}?

toasts.differenceRequired: The difference must be {amount} to finish reconciliation
toasts.success: {count, plural, one {Successfully reconciled # transaction} other {Successfully reconciled # transactions}}
toasts.voidStatus: A void transaction can only be changed from the transaction form

delete.title: Delete Transaction
delete.message: Delete this transaction? It will be removed from the account and from this reconciliation.
delete.transferMessage: Delete this transfer? Both sides of it are removed, in this account and in the other one.

stale.missedTooltip: This transaction is dated on or before the last statement you reconciled, so that statement was reconciled without it.
stale.overdueTooltip: This transaction has been waiting to be reconciled for longer than a statement cycle.

reminder.title: Reconciliation
reminder.badgeLabel: {count, plural, one {# transaction waiting to be reconciled} other {# transactions waiting to be reconciled}}
reminder.accountLine: {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}, oldest {date}
reminder.missedLine: {count, plural, one {# left out of a reconciled statement} other {# left out of reconciled statements}}
reminder.overdueLine: {count, plural, one {# older than {days} days} other {# older than {days} days}}
